products.description:
American Dream Cocoa Butter Lemon Cream is a rich body moisturiser formulated with mineral oil, glycerin, shea butter extract, cocoa extract, lemon oil and vitamin E. It is designed to soften dry skin and leave it feeling smoother and moisturised.

The cream can be used as part of a daily body-care routine, particularly on dry areas. Lemon oil provides the characteristic citrus element, while the emollient-rich base helps reduce the dry, tight feeling of the skin.

American Dream Cocoa Butter Lemon Cream ni cream ikungahaye igenewe gutunganya umubiri, irimo mineral oil, glycerin, shea butter extract, cocoa extract, lemon oil na vitamine E. Ifasha uruhu rwumagaye kumva rworoshye, rutoshye kandi rufite ubuhehere.

Ishobora gukoreshwa buri munsi mu kwita ku mubiri, cyane cyane ku bice bikunda kumagara. Lemon oil itanga impumuro yihariye ya citrus, mu gihe ibindi bigize cream bifasha uruhu kugumana ubworoherane.

products.name: Asantee Papaya & Honey Soap 125g

products.description:
Asantee Papaya & Honey Soap is a 125g herbal cleansing bar made with papaya extract, honey, coconut-derived cleansing ingredients and other skin-conditioning components. Papaya is commonly used in cosmetic cleansing products for its exfoliating and brightening properties, while honey helps support a soft, conditioned skin feel.

It is marketed for face and body use and can be incorporated into a regular cleansing routine. The rich lather helps remove everyday impurities while the formula is designed to leave skin feeling smoother and refreshed.

Asantee Papaya & Honey Soap ni isabune y'ibimera ya 125g irimo papaya extract, ubuki, ibikoresho bikomoka kuri coconut n'ibindi bifasha gutunganya uruhu. Papaya ikoreshwa cyane mu bicuruzwa byita ku ruhu kubera uruhare rwayo mu gukuraho uturemangingo twapfuye no gufasha uruhu kugaragara rufite urumuri, mu gihe ubuki bufasha uruhu kumva rworoshye.

Yamamazwa nk'isabune ishobora gukoreshwa mu maso no ku mubiri. Ifuro ryayo rifasha gukuraho umwanda wa buri munsi, uruhu rugasigara rwumva rutoshye kandi rufite isuku.

Its light perfume gives a soft, clean baby scent. As with all baby products, apply to clean skin and avoid the eye area.

Parfum yayo yoroheje itanga impumuro nziza y'abana. Kimwe n'ibindi bicuruzwa by'abana, yikoreshwa ku ruhu rufite isuku kandi ukirinda amaso.

products.description:
Barakkat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance in the well-known Rouge 540 scent family. Fragrance descriptions characterise it with a saffron and jasmine opening over a warm base of amber, cedar and fir resin.

It is a strong, long-lasting composition — a small application on pulse points is usually enough. Performance varies with skin chemistry, climate and application.

Ni parfum ikomeye kandi imara igihe kirekire — gutera gake ku bice bifite ubushyuhe birahagije. Uko imara giterwa n'uruhu, ikirere n'ingano yakoreshejwe.

products.name: Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Serum Gold 14 Days Face & Body Serum
products.nameRw: Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Serum Gold y'Iminsi 14 yo mu Maso no ku Mubiri
products.description:
Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Serum Gold is a face and body serum marketed for brightening, moisturising, firming and improving the appearance of uneven skin tone. Product listings identify ingredients such as kojic acid and L-glutathione, with some versions also listing egg yolk, papaya extract, alpha arbutin and vitamin C.

The product is marketed with a 14-day results claim, but individual results vary and cannot be guaranteed. Consistent application and daily sun protection are important when using brightening products.
products.descriptionRw:
Pure Egyptian Magic Whitening Serum Gold ni serumu ikoreshwa mu maso no ku mubiri, igamije gufasha uruhu kugaragara rufite urumuri, ubuhehere n'ibara riringaniye. Amakuru y'ibicuruzwa agaragaza ibintu nka kojic acid na L-glutathione, mu gihe hari n'imiterere imwe igaragaza egg yolk, papaya extract, alpha arbutin na vitamine C.

Ibicuruzwa bigaragaza ko ibisubizo bishobora kugaragara mu minsi 14, ariko ibisubizo biratandukana bitewe n'umuntu kandi ntibishobora kwizezwa. Gukoresha neza serumu no kurinda uruhu izuba ni ingenzi.
products.shortDescription: Brightening face and body serum marketed to improve the appearance of dark spots and uneven tone.
products.shortDescriptionRw: Serumu yo mu maso no ku mubiri ifasha kugaragaza uruhu ruringaniye kandi rufite urumuri.
products.ingredients: ["Ingredient disclosure varies by market and product version. Public listings identify Kojic Acid","L-Glutathione","Egg Yolk Extract and SPF 20; other listings also identify Butylene Glycol","Papaya Extract","Alpha Arbutin","Vitamin C","AHA","Glycerin and Carrageenan Extract. Verify the exact package label before publishing a regulatory ingredient claim."]
products.ingredientsRw: Kojic acid na L-glutathione ni ibintu byamamazwa mu gufasha uruhu kugaragara ruringaniye kandi rufite urumuri. Glycerin ifasha ubuhehere. Papaya extract na AHA bishobora gufasha mu kuvugurura uruhu. Ibigize serumu bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'isoko, bityo label iri ku icupa ni yo igomba kwizerwa.
products.howToUse: 1. Cleanse and dry the face or body area. 2. Apply a small amount of serum. 3. Massage gently until evenly distributed. 4. Use morning and evening if tolerated and according to the package directions. 5. Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen during daytime.
products.howToUseRw: 1. Sukura ahantu ushaka kuyishyira kandi uhahanagure hakume. 2. Shyiraho serumu nke. 3. Korakora witonze kugeza ikwirakwiye. 4. Ushobora kuyikoresha mu gitondo no nimugoroba niba uruhu ruyihanganira kandi ukurikije amabwiriza ari ku gapaki. 5. Ku manywa koresha sunscreen irinda uruhu izuba.
products.warnings: For external use only. Patch test before widespread use. Avoid eyes, lips and broken or irritated skin. Stop use if burning, severe redness or persistent irritation occurs. Brightening products can increase sensitivity; use sunscreen during daytime. Store away from heat and direct sunlight.
products.warningsRw: Ni iyo gukoresha ku ruhu gusa. Banza uyipime ku gice gito cy'uruhu. Irinde amaso, iminwa n'ahantu hafite ibikomere cyangwa harakaye. Niba itera gutwika cyane, gutukura bikabije cyangwa kurakara bikomeje, hagarika kuyikoresha. Koresha sunscreen ku manywa. Yibike kure y'ubushyuhe n'izuba.
products.expectedResults: The product is marketed to improve the appearance of dark spots and uneven tone, with visible improvement claimed within about 14 days. Results vary by skin type, routine and sun exposure.
products.expectedResultsRw: Yamamazwa nk'igicuruzwa gifasha kugabanya uko utubara twijimye n'ibara ritangana bigaragara. Hari abashobora kubona impinduka mu gihe kingana n'iminsi 14, ariko ibisubizo biratandukana bitewe n'uruhu n'imikoreshereze.
